title: Will McDonald questionable for Jets, Minkah Fitzpatrick ruled out

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Will McDonald questionable for Jets, Minkah Fitzpatrick ruled out
sources.description: The Jets will be missing a handful of players as they try to open a season with a 2-0 record for the first time since 2015, but they hope linebacker Will McDonald won't be one of them.
